title: [CFG-01] Create the Catalogue Objects
description:
Implementation plan task: CFG-01
Source: Employee Management ADRs 001–004 implementation plan; specification accepted October 28, 2026.

Category:
Catalogues and initial configuration records

Objective:
Provide the approved choices before configuring the remaining objects.

Detailed scope:
Create Login Location Rule (TG_LoginLocationRuleObject) and Assignment Location Basis (TG_AssignmentLocationBasisObject) in the approved application. Configure Code, localizable Name, Active? default TRUE and Sort; unique stable codes and inactive-value retention. Load SAME_HOME / Same as Home Location / TRUE / 10, HOME_PARENT / Home Location's Parent / TRUE / 20, HOME / Home Location / TRUE / 10 and LOGIN / Login Location / TRUE / 20 under their respective catalogues. Do not add native Id fields or an abstract catalogue family.

Deliverable:
Configured the Catalogue Objects with the specified fields or behavior and local configuration checks complete.

Strict technical prerequisites:
None

Blocked status:
Blocked — requires supplied Application placement and object/field names.

Recommended implementer role:
Associate Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role:
Senior Consultant

Role rationale:
Two bounded catalogue configurations use established object, field and initial-value patterns.

Acceptance criteria:
Both catalogues have the four specified fields and their own two initial records.
Codes are stable and unique; inactive historical references remain valid.

Specification references:
Sections 6.1–6.2.

Assumptions and open questions:
None

Specification references:
Sections 4.2, 7.1–7.4.

Assumptions and open questions:
Execute after CFG-01 under the specification’s catalogue-first build order; this is an ordering instruction, not a technical dependency on catalogue data.

title: [AUT-01] Configure the Employee Position Code Action Handler
description:
Implementation plan task: AUT-01
Source: Employee Management ADRs 001–004 implementation plan; specification accepted October 28, 2026.

Category:
Automation and services

Objective:
Resolve the incoming Position Code, create missing authoring records, retain all waiting Employees and provide the initial login-location calculation.

Detailed scope:
Configure the complete Employee Action Handler sequence. Verify the supplied integration actor and mark only authorized integration creation; skip empty JobCode; use FETCHVALUE to resolve an exact case-sensitive Position Code.Code and capture an existing current publication only into an empty Position Code Version. Distinguish a genuine no-match from an ambiguous match or failed record search. For a genuine no-match, use the supplied GETRELATED create/resolve behavior to create one authoring Position Code, set Code and integration origin, initialize its initial workflow and assign [Helper] Create New Position Code Relation. Join the same helper cohort when a code already exists but is unpublished. Resolve concurrent creation and first-publication races through the supplied shared control; confirm Source Employees inverse before notification; clear/re-resolve helpers before publication when JobCode changes, retain origin after capture, preserve existing versions and suppress recursive internal saves. Configure the reusable initial login-location calculation from Position Code Version.Login Location Rule and Employee.Location: SAME_HOME uses Home Location; HOME_PARENT uses ParentLocation or falls back to Home Location. Reject missing/invalid location codes. AUT-08 uses only this calculation, not the complete creation handler, and remains responsible for membership changes, stored preparation references and completion timestamp.

Deliverable:
Configured Employee Action Handler and reusable initial login-location calculation, with shared coordination and local configuration checks complete.

Strict technical prerequisites:
CFG-03, CFG-04, CFG-07, WF-01

Blocked status:
Blocked — requires supplied Native record matching and Employee event contract; Publication transaction and retry contract; also awaits CFG-03, CFG-04, CFG-07, WF-01.

Recommended implementer role:
Senior Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role:
Principal Consultant

Role rationale:
The combined assignment includes concurrent record creation, capture, source tracking, native event coordination and safe retry. These require Senior Consultant ownership even though its bounded calculations could otherwise be configured at a lower role.

Acceptance criteria:
Empty JobCode creates no record search or Position Code; ambiguous/failed record matching cannot create a new code.
Concurrent same-code arrivals create one authoring record/workflow and retain every waiting Employee through the helper inverse.
Existing active versions are captured once; later edits do not overwrite captures, lose sources during first publication or restart initial setup.
The reusable login-location calculation handles both catalogue codes and the missing-ParentLocation fallback; missing codes keep preparation incomplete.

Specification references:
Sections 6.1, 8.1–8.2, 13.4.

Assumptions and open questions:
Combined at the user’s request. Keep record matching, missing-code creation, source coordination and the reusable location calculation in one assignable task; AUT-08 owns the separate membership/preparation outcome.

title: [AUT-04] Configure the Setup Notification
description:
Implementation plan task: AUT-04
Source: Employee Management ADRs 001–004 implementation plan; specification accepted October 28, 2026.

Category:
Notifications and automation

Objective:
Provide the setup message and deliver it once after at least one source Employee is linked.

Detailed scope:
Create the supplied Position Code Setup Required template with code link, source Employees available at sending time, live Source Employees link and setup/Publish instructions. Configure the approved Administrators recipient expression and native default-email settings. Configure guarded delivery after AUT-01 confirms the helper/inverse association; require Created by Paylocity Integration=TRUE, Setup Notification Sent=FALSE and at least one Employee in Source Employees. Use the supplied native delivery/deduplication method; set Setup Notification Sent only after successful delivery. Preserve retry eligibility and native failure evidence. Manual creation, later source arrivals and later publications send no duplicate. Do not add completion, reminder or escalation templates.

Deliverable:
Configured setup template, recipients and once-only delivery automation, with local configuration checks complete.

Strict technical prerequisites:
AUT-01

Blocked status:
Blocked — requires supplied Notification delivery contract; Native record matching and Employee event contract; also awaits AUT-01.

Recommended implementer role:
Senior Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role:
Senior Consultant

Role rationale:
Template setup is routine, but the combined delivery ordering, deduplication and send/flag failure handling require Senior Consultant ownership.

Acceptance criteria:
The template identifies the code, available source Employees and correct live source grid, and targets the supplied Administrators recipient expression.
No message is sent before helper/source association is confirmed.
Successful delivery marks Setup Notification Sent; failed delivery remains retryable without repeating a successful message.
No extra notification type or later-publication message is introduced.

Specification references:
Sections 9.4, EM-002.

Assumptions and open questions:
Combined at the user’s request; one task owns both message configuration and guarded once-only delivery.

title: [AUT-07] Configure the Publish Routine
description:
Implementation plan task: AUT-07
Source: Employee Management ADRs 001–004 implementation plan; specification accepted October 28, 2026.

Category:
Automation and services

Objective:
Publish a complete version and preserve prior setup if any required change fails.

Detailed scope:
Configure one common publication routine for initial and Completed-record Publish. Apply the supplied permission, saved-revision, lifecycle, per-code lock and retry-identity methods. Validate active catalogue choices, group eligibility and unique Role rows; hold profiles needing deferred Roles. Allocate version number, call AUT-05, validate copies, and set Current Published Version. On first publication call AUT-06 and complete Initial Setup to Completed in the same controlled change; later publication skips Employee writeback and stays Completed. Complete publication before the after-commit preparation handoff wired in AUT-09. Roll back required effects on failure while retaining authoring edits; reconcile uncertain/repeated attempts before another version is created.

Deliverable:
Configured the Publish Routine with the specified fields or behavior and local configuration checks complete.

Strict technical prerequisites:
AUT-05, AUT-06, WF-01

Blocked status:
Blocked — requires supplied Publication transaction and retry contract; Workflow and Completed-link configuration; Native record matching and Employee event contract; also awaits AUT-05, AUT-06, WF-01.

Recommended implementer role:
Senior Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role:
Principal Consultant

Role rationale:
Cross-record publication, workflow termination, locking and retry are high-consequence native behavior.

Acceptance criteria:
First publication creates the complete version, source assignments and Completed outcome together.
A failed initial/later publication leaves the correct prior pointer/status and no active partial version.
A retry/double-click cannot create another version for an already successful attempt.

Specification references:
Sections 9.2–9.3.

Assumptions and open questions:
Kept as one consequential automation task because version activation, first-source assignments and workflow completion must share one controlled operation; copy and selection work is already separated.

title: [WF-02] Configure Position Code Workflow — Full
description:
Implementation plan task: WF-02
Source: Employee Management ADRs 001–004 implementation plan; specification accepted October 28, 2026.

Category:
Configure workflow — full

Objective:
Finish the initial Publish action and the subsequent Completed-record Publish link.

Detailed scope:
Bind Initial Setup Publish to AUT-07 and configure action availability, required validations and the specified user-facing error messages. Apply supplied native responsibility/due-date decisions without inventing dates. Bind the Position Code form Publish link so the first invocation performs the initial workflow action and later invocations publish while remaining Completed. Recheck Administrator rights on execution. Do not add cancellation/reopen actions or a Published Position Code workflow; do not send an additional custom completion notification.

Deliverable:
Configured Position Code Workflow — Full with the specified fields or behavior and local configuration checks complete.

Strict technical prerequisites:
UI-02, AUT-07

Blocked status:
Blocked — requires supplied Workflow and Completed-link configuration; also awaits UI-02, AUT-07.

Recommended implementer role:
Senior Associate Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role:
Senior Consultant

Role rationale:
Final ordinary workflow/link rules fit Senior Associate capability because consequential publication automation is isolated in AUT-07.

Acceptance criteria:
The only workflow action is visible Publish in Initial Setup.
The form link remains available to authorized Administrators in Completed without restarting workflow.
Errors and action availability match section 9; native default notifications follow supplied settings.

Specification references:
Sections 9.1–9.4, 11.

Assumptions and open questions:
None

title: [AUT-08] Configure Initial Membership Preparation
description:
Implementation plan task: AUT-08
Source: Employee Management ADRs 001–004 implementation plan; specification accepted October 28, 2026.

Category:
Automation and services

Objective:
Prepare initial group memberships and location instructions once for each eligible Employee.

Detailed scope:
Configure the shared routine for integration-managed, eligible Employees with an empty completion timestamp and valid captured version matching current code. Add missing native memberships from Position Code Version.Groups, preserving unrelated memberships and avoiding duplicate additions. Invoke the reusable login-location calculation configured within AUT-01; store Initial Login Location and Initial Profile Home Location, validate their codes, and stamp Initial Profile Applied On last with timezone support. Hold deferred Role requirements. On partial failure preserve successful memberships, leave completion empty and retain native errors; safely finish missing work on retry.

Deliverable:
Configured Initial Membership Preparation with the specified fields or behavior and local configuration checks complete.

Strict technical prerequisites:
CFG-06, AUT-01

Blocked status:
Blocked — requires supplied Native membership and preparation contract; Native record matching and Employee event contract; also awaits CFG-06, AUT-01.

Recommended implementer role:
Senior Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role:
Senior Consultant

Role rationale:
Native membership changes, Employee locks and safe retry require Senior Consultant handling.

Acceptance criteria:
A repeated run adds no duplicate membership and removes no unrelated membership.
Timestamp is populated only after all required membership/location work succeeds.
Invalid/mismatched capture, missing location codes and deferred required Roles keep the record incomplete.

Specification references:
Sections 8.2, 13.4.

Assumptions and open questions:
Kept combined because the membership result, location snapshots and completion checkpoint represent one initial preparation outcome.

title: [AUT-09] Configure the Employee Preparation Service
description:
Implementation plan task: AUT-09
Source: Employee Management ADRs 001–004 implementation plan; specification accepted October 28, 2026.

Category:
Automation and services

Objective:
Continue ready or partially completed setup after the originating request has committed.

Detailed scope:
Configure the approved after-commit invocation and Event Service to call AUT-08 from Employee capture and successful first publication, and to resume eligible incomplete records. Apply supplied cadence, eligible-record rules, concurrency, retry and error ownership; the specification’s five-minute interval is not assumed approved. Do not call preparation while inbound or publication changes remain uncommitted and do not reset completed Employees.

Deliverable:
Configured the Employee Preparation Service with the specified fields or behavior and local configuration checks complete.

Strict technical prerequisites:
AUT-07, AUT-08

Blocked status:
Blocked — requires supplied Native membership and preparation contract; Feed and service operating parameters; also awaits AUT-07, AUT-08.

Recommended implementer role:
Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role:
Senior Consultant

Role rationale:
Service scheduling and event wiring are moderately complex once locking/preparation behavior is supplied.

Acceptance criteria:
After-commit triggers and the scheduled selection use the same preparation routine.
Completed records are not selected for initial membership replay; incomplete failures remain visible for approved continuation.

Specification references:
Sections 8.2, 9.2 step 7.

Assumptions and open questions:
None

title: [INT-01] Configure Establishment Rules
description:
Implementation plan task: INT-01
Source: Employee Management ADRs 001–004 implementation plan; specification accepted October 28, 2026.

Category:
Integrations

Objective:
Deliver the correct Home Location while preserving approved establishment corrections.

Detailed scope:
Configure the supplied ordered establishment rules in Boomi for new employees, relocations and job changes: assigned/actual established site first; otherwise San Diego for remote California residents; otherwise the designated main established site for the remote employee’s job function. Configure the supplied source fields, site-to-LocationCode and job-function-to-main-site mappings and conflicting-site resolution. Apply the chosen durable correction authority and clear/precedence rules. Hold missing/conflicting required inputs or mappings rather than choose a default. Preserve rule/version/input evidence in the supplied native support mechanism; create no new correction store or reporting-chain traversal.

Deliverable:
Configured Establishment Rules with the specified fields or behavior and local configuration checks complete.

Strict technical prerequisites:
None

Blocked status:
Blocked — ordered assignment rules supplied; requires Establishment mappings, conflicting-site resolution and correction authority; Boomi payload and identity contract.

Recommended implementer role:
Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role:
Senior Consultant

Role rationale:
Moderate source transformation and governed correction handling need Consultant judgment; the ordered rule is supplied and remaining mappings/correction authority are external.

Acceptance criteria:
An assigned/actual established site wins over residence, including a California resident assigned to another established site.
A remote California resident resolves to San Diego; a remote non-California resident resolves to the designated main established site for their job function.
New employees, relocations and job changes trigger calculation; missing/ambiguous inputs required by the applicable branch hold affected delivery rather than fall through to a default.
An approved override survives later feeds until its defined clear condition, and incomplete data is held.

Specification references:
Sections 10.1.

Assumptions and open questions:
None

title: [INT-02] Configure Direct Employee Delivery
description:
Implementation plan task: INT-02
Source: Employee Management ADRs 001–004 implementation plan; specification accepted October 28, 2026.

Category:
Integrations

Objective:
Create or update Intelex Employees directly from the approved Paylocity feed.

Detailed scope:
Configure Boomi’s supported EmployeeUserAccess request mapping using the supplied endpoint contract and field allowlist. Map Position Code to JobCode, employee identity to EmployeeNumber, DateOfHire to native DateHired and HomeLocationCode from INT-01. Initial creation uses IgnoreUserAccess=TRUE. Omit Groups/custom Employee fields and both business-hierarchy properties; keep both removal controls FALSE and use supplied SendEmail/other flag decisions. Preserve optional-field omission versus explicit clearing, capacities/date formats, minimum pre-start inputs and approved feed timing.

Deliverable:
Configured Direct Employee Delivery with the specified fields or behavior and local configuration checks complete.

Strict technical prerequisites:
INT-01

Blocked status:
Blocked — requires supplied Boomi payload and identity contract; Feed and service operating parameters; also awaits INT-01.

Recommended implementer role:
Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role:
Senior Consultant

Role rationale:
Direct service mapping, conditional controls and external feed handling are moderately complex integration configuration.

Acceptance criteria:
The direct request contains the supported employee-only contract with JobCode carrying Position Code.
Custom helper/checkpoint fields, Groups and hierarchy assignments are absent; date/null handling and controls match the supplied mapping.

Specification references:
Sections 1, 8.1, 10–10.2.

Assumptions and open questions:
None

title: [INT-03] Configure Employee Delivery Retry
description:
Implementation plan task: INT-03
Source: Employee Management ADRs 001–004 implementation plan; specification accepted October 28, 2026.

Category:
Integrations

Objective:
Resume uncertain delivery against the correct native Employee instead of creating duplicates.

Detailed scope:
Configure per-EmployeeNumber serialization and the supplied Number/Id reconciliation in the Boomi delivery flow. Before repeating creation, distinguish no match, one matching Employee and ambiguous matches; resume one valid Id, hold ambiguity, and retain native outcome/correlation evidence. Treat a timeout as unknown outcome and never create another Employee to recover profile preparation failure. Apply the externally resolved identity-change/rehire decisions only within their supplied mapping.

Deliverable:
Configured Employee Delivery Retry with the specified fields or behavior and local configuration checks complete.

Strict technical prerequisites:
INT-02

Blocked status:
Blocked — requires supplied Boomi payload and identity contract; also awaits INT-02.

Recommended implementer role:
Senior Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role:
Principal Consultant

Role rationale:
Identity, concurrency and uncertain-outcome reconciliation have substantial access/integration consequences.

Acceptance criteria:
Unknown outcomes are reconciled before any repeated POST.
One valid Employee continues by native Id and multiple matches cannot trigger automatic creation.

Specification references:
Sections 10, EM-008.

Assumptions and open questions:
None

title: [INT-04] Configure Account Activation
description:
Implementation plan task: INT-04
Source: Employee Management ADRs 001–004 implementation plan; specification accepted October 28, 2026.

Category:
Integrations

Objective:
Enable access for the same Employee after profile and organizational identity are ready.

Detailed scope:
Configure Boomi’s approved Employee readiness reads and later EmployeeUserAccess PATCH. Require populated Initial Profile Applied On, valid Position Code Version and Initial Login Location, current Home Location matching Initial Profile Home Location, SSO UserId and LicenseType. Read LoginLocationCode from the stored initial location. Use IgnoreUserAccess=FALSE only for eligible activation and omit Groups. Preserve captured profile and memberships, keep removal controls FALSE, and avoid routinely overwriting manual login exceptions on later updates. Use native access evidence/endpoint outcome rather than the preparation timestamp as proof an account exists.

Deliverable:
Configured Account Activation with the specified fields or behavior and local configuration checks complete.

Strict technical prerequisites:
CFG-07, INT-03

Blocked status:
Blocked — requires supplied Boomi payload and identity contract; Native membership and preparation contract; also awaits CFG-07, INT-03.

Recommended implementer role:
Senior Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role:
Principal Consultant

Role rationale:
Cross-system access gating and employee-only-to-account transition require Senior Consultant authority.

Acceptance criteria:
Incomplete profile, changed Home Location or missing SSO/license prevents activation.
A ready Employee receives the access request by existing Id without Groups or loss of prepared memberships.

Specification references:
Sections 8.3, 10.

Assumptions and open questions:
None

title: [RPT-01] Configure Employee Setup Views
description:
Implementation plan task: RPT-01
Source: Employee Management ADRs 001–004 implementation plan; specification accepted October 28, 2026.

Category:
Reports

Objective:
Give authorized support a clear view of waiting and failed setup.

Detailed scope:
Configure the specified native views for unpublished Position Codes, profiles awaiting publication, Employees awaiting a captured profile, incomplete preparation, failed processing and ambiguous identity matches. Use existing Position Code/Employee fields and supplied native execution-error sources; show Source Employees separately from ordinary usage. Keep checkpoint and account-activation meaning distinct and apply permitted Employee drill-through. No new log object or expanded analytics report is included.

Deliverable:
Configured Employee Setup Views with the specified fields or behavior and local configuration checks complete.

Strict technical prerequisites:
CFG-03, CFG-04, CFG-07

Blocked status:
Blocked — requires supplied Security and audit control map; Native record matching and Employee event contract; also awaits CFG-03, CFG-04, CFG-07.

Recommended implementer role:
Senior Associate Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role:
Senior Consultant

Role rationale:
Related-record filters and protected support navigation fit Senior Associate reporting capability.

Acceptance criteria:
Views identify the specified waiting/failed populations using existing fields and approved native evidence.
Employee links obey the supplied access controls and Source Employees has its own distinct meaning.

Specification references:
Sections 8, 11, 12.3.

Assumptions and open questions:
None

title: [INIT-01] Configure Initial Position Code Profiles
description:
Implementation plan task: INIT-01
Source: Employee Management ADRs 001–004 implementation plan; specification accepted October 28, 2026.

Category:
Catalogues and initial configuration records

Objective:
Provide the agreed initial profiles using the completed authoring and Publish controls.

Detailed scope:
Create only the externally supplied exact Position Codes and their Login Location Rule, Security Groups, Training Workgroups and Document Distribution Groups. Use the configured Publish link to create complete immutable versions and complete each initial workflow. Keep code case and all three group categories intact. Do not invent seed Position Codes, enrol existing Employees, perform migration/backfill or publish profiles that need the deferred Role feature.

Deliverable:
Configured Initial Position Code Profiles with the specified fields or behavior and local configuration checks complete.

Strict technical prerequisites:
WF-02

Blocked status:
Blocked — requires supplied Initial Position Code profiles; also awaits WF-02.

Recommended implementer role:
Senior Associate Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role:
Senior Consultant

Role rationale:
Initial governed configuration requires independent judgment but does not implement publication automation.

Acceptance criteria:
Every supplied in-scope nondeferred profile has the required approved selections and one complete first publication.
No unapproved code, migration cohort or location-qualified Role configuration is introduced.

Specification references:
Sections 6–7, 9, 12.1.

Assumptions and open questions:
None
